halfLife.notes: Once-daily dosing typical, often at night because of sedation. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

cypInteractions.switchingRelevance: Strong CYP1A2 inhibitors (fluvoxamine, ciprofloxacin) markedly raise olanzapine levels — avoid combining; smoking induces CYP1A2 so smokers may need higher doses. Relevant when cross-tapering with fluvoxamine. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

metabolicRisk.notes: Among the worst SGAs for weight gain, glucose dysregulation, and dyslipidaemia. A primary driver of switches off olanzapine. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

lai.notes: Zyprexa Relprevv (olanzapine pamoate). Use restricted in MY due to post-injection delirium/sedation syndrome risk requiring 3-hour observation. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

reboundPsychosisRisk.notes: Cholinergic and histaminergic rebound on abrupt cessation; consider gradual taper if stopping. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

formulationNotes: Standard tablets and orodispersible (Zydis) tablets available. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
